reason: The free one-pager costs me nothing and he is local out of Roscoe, so I would let him send it. But I do not hand $250 to a stranger off a cold pitch in a normal week, I would read the page first and see if he actually knows HVAC work.
objection: Everyone is selling AI now and I cannot risk a half-baked tool mouthing off to my customers or blowing up my dispatch. A one-page write-up from somebody I have never met does not prove he can do the work.
would_change_my_mind: The free page names something real about my business, my actual missed-call log, my actual Monday paperwork, and then a 15-minute call with two references from HVAC or plumbing shops my size who will say he answered the phone when it broke.
